deliverables: Open standardized interface across Cardano on-chain protocols
Developer and agent coverage for onboarded protocols
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe, an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.

Tx3 is intended to provide a shared interface layer that lets developers and AI agents discover, integrate, and compose Cardano protocols through documentation, SDKs, JSON-RPC endpoints, MCP tooling, and protocol skills.
The proposal says there is currently no common interface mechanism across the Cardano ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and rebuild protocol understanding independently.
The proposal says TxPipe has already put the developer layer into production through Catalyst Fund 14 with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal commits to 12 additional protocol onboardings, scheduled as 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage.
The proposal states that Strike Finance, Indigo Protocol, VyFinance, Bodega Market, and Fluid Tokens are already accessible through Tx3.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

The proposal states that oversight will include Intersect administration, technically capable third-party oversight, reporting obligations, milestone-based disbursement controls, and smart-contract controls involving Intersect admins, leadership, and a six-entity Oversight Committee.

The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus Intersect 2025 open-source maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC being delivered on schedule.

summary: The anchor requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month Tx3 expansion covering protocol onboardings, agent-facing infrastructure, SDKs, documentation, and JSON-RPC endpoints, with Intersect smart-contract administration and several external references for governance and oversight verification.
